questions.stem:
Caller: Hi, I'd like to speak to Mr. Brown, please.

Receptionist: ---

Which response is professional?
options: May I ask who's calling, please?
questions.explanation: Polite way to ask for the caller's name.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Person A: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat it?

What does 'didn't catch that' mean?
options: I didn't hear or understand what you said.
questions.explanation: Informal way to say 'I didn't hear or understand.'
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: Voice message: "Hi, it's Jane. Please call me back when you get a chance." What does Jane want?
questions.explanation: Jane is requesting a callback at the listener's convenience.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: Read: "I'll put you through to the manager." Who is probably speaking?
questions.explanation: Putting someone through means transferring the call—typical of reception.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Caller: Is Emma there?

Emma's sister: ---

Which response is appropriate if Emma is busy?
options: She's not available at the moment. Can I take a message?
questions.explanation: Sister explains and offers to take a message.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "The line went dead." What probably happened?
options: The connection was lost or the call ended suddenly.
questions.explanation: Line went dead means the connection was lost.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: Text: "Can't talk now, in a meeting. Will text you later." What is the sender doing?
options: Politely deferring the conversation because they are busy.
questions.explanation: Sender explains they are busy and promises to respond later.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: You answer a call and hear: "Sorry, wrong number." How might you respond?
options: No problem. Have a good day.
questions.explanation: Polite, brief response to an honest mistake.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "I'm in a bad signal area. Can you hear me?" What might the other person experience?
options: Poor audio quality or cutting out due to weak signal.
questions.explanation: Bad signal causes poor call quality.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Speaker: I have to go—my battery's dying. Talk soon!

What does 'my battery's dying' mean?
options: The phone battery is running out.
questions.explanation: Colloquial for the phone battery is low.
questions.subject: ing
